text:
Emma (CS): Quick retro on the Lilypad go-live — saw the surge and some jitter during tenant priming. Capturing what helped (prefill + small warm pools + streaming fallback) and what we should change before next ramp. Short notes please. 

Diego (Eng-Runtime): Saw heavy prefix reuse — KV cache hit ~65% first 5m. Prefill TTL was too short; extend and stagger prefill. metrics: cache_hit_rate=0.65, avg_latency=120ms

Maya (Solutions): Customer will ramp 3x next week. We recommended staged canary rollout (10% -> 50% -> 100%) and pre-warm. They asked for a simple runbook we can hand them.

Sam (SRE): GPU scheduling spikes in first 10m. We spun up burst nodes and decreased batch size 32->16 to keep p95 under 200ms. Suggest autoscale tweak: burst_headroom=20% and lower coldstart_cooldown to 30s.

Ava (CSM): Renewal risk = medium. They experienced timeouts in demo flows. Action: schedule enablement call this week, share a one-pager with config + quick checks. I'll own follow-up.

Diego (Eng-Runtime): Streaming success rate dipped to ~90% due to client timeouts. Recommend server-side chunk keepalive and client retry backoff (start 1s, cap 10s).

Maya (Solutions): Draft starter config for CS handoff. Will include fallback model guidance and telemetry points to watch.

Config snippet:
```
prefill:
  enabled: true
  ttl_secs: 3600
  stagger_secs: 60
batch:
  target_size: 16
  max_latency_ms: 150
stream:
  keepalive_secs: 8
  retry_attempts: 2
```

Sam (SRE): I'll add a dashboard tile: "Lilypad warmup — cache_hit, p95, p99_latency" and a quick alert: p99 > 350ms -> paging policy.

Diego (Eng-Runtime): Note: avoid relying on long-lived prefix caches for tenants that rewrite PII — cache TTLs + validation needed.

Maya (Solutions): Also add a renewal risk rule: if latency >200ms on top 3 flows for 24h, escalate to AM/CS.

Emma (CS): Thanks — follow-ups: Ava -> one-pager, Sam -> dashboard & alert, Diego -> infra autoscale tweak + streaming keepalive, Maya -> customer comms + one-pager draft. Check-in ETA 48h. :white_check_mark:
